name: Play Sheet Music
description: Ask Claude to generate and play some sheet music for you with a visual component.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Play Sheet Music to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Play Sheet Music to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://example-server.modelcontextprotocol.io/sheet-music/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Play Sheet Music?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Play Sheet Music in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Play Sheet Music MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Play Sheet Music requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Play Sheet Music is developed by Model Context Protocol Community. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
